root_cause.text: The IFF_OVS_DATAPATH flag was cleared prematurely in ovs_netdev_detach_dev() before completing the netdev teardown operations, allowing a concurrent netdev_destroy() to free the device while those operations (e.g., dev_set_promiscuity) were still in progress.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "The ovs_netdev_detach_dev() function clears the flag before completing the unregistration... netdev_destroy() can complete and the device can be freed before the unregistration completes." The patch moves the flag clearing to after the other operations and adds memory barriers to enforce ordering.
